name: Push past
summary: Entering a world: past a doorframe, a plant, a shelf edge; adds depth and a natural wipe.

data.about: A forward glide that brushes past an object close to the lens; the foreground sweeps out of frame and the space beyond opens up.
data.avoid: Scenes with no foreground layer to pass (it becomes a plain dolly in).

amount.what: share of the subject distance travelled
